EV Charge — install from APK (no app store)
===========================================

File
----
  EVChargeEstimation-1.0.0.apk

What it needs
-------------
  - Android 9 or newer
  - Camera optional (you can type numbers by hand)
  - No account, no internet required for core features

How to install
--------------
  1. Copy the APK to your phone (download link, USB, cloud drive, etc.).
  2. Open the file on the phone.
  3. If Android blocks it, allow “Install unknown apps” for your browser
     or file manager (Settings → Apps → Special access → Install unknown apps).
  4. Tap Install, then Open.

Updates
-------
  The app can check GitHub for a newer version (home screen → “Check for updates”,
  or a banner when one is available). Download, then Install when prompted.

  Or grab the latest APK from:
    https://github.com/boristomas/EVChargeEstimation/releases/latest

  Updates must be signed with the same developer key to install over the old app.

Permissions you may be asked for
--------------------------------
  - Camera — only for scanning the car display
  - Notifications — only if you set a charge timer/alarm

Privacy
-------
  - No login
  - No ads
  - History stays on the phone
  - Screen reading runs on the device
